howItWorks.label: How it works
howItWorks.subtext: Most tools polish what you already have. Devometrics tells you what's actually missing.
howItWorks.step1Description: Sign in and complete your professional profile. Then our AI conducts a short conversational interview — not a form — to understand what you actually do, decide, and lead.
howItWorks.step2Description: Drop in your CV (or coursework/projects if you don't have one yet), a target job description, and the role you're aiming for. The engine ingests all three simultaneously to build a competency map you couldn't assemble from any single source.
howItWorks.step3Description: Devometrics extracts your real competencies across 8 fixed dimensions — technical, leadership, communication, strategic thinking, and more — scores each one, and maps the precise gaps between where you are and where the role demands you to be.
howItWorks.step4Description: Receive a prioritized, time-bound development roadmap: 30-day quick wins, 90-day milestones, 12-month targets. Specific courses, certifications, projects, and coaching actions — ranked by impact on your gap, not just popularity.

features.label: Platform features
features.f1Description: A short conversational interview that extracts your real capabilities — what you decide, lead, and own — building a richer profile than any checkbox form.
features.f2Description: Your skills scored across 8 fixed dimensions with Current Level, Target Level, Gap Size, Market Demand, and a Confidence Score. Not guesses — extracted from your actual documents.
features.f3Description: 30-day / 90-day / 12-month / 3-year plans drawing from 9 formats — reading, research, courses, certifications, webinars, hands-on work, mentorship, peer learning, live cohorts — matched to your budget and how you actually learn. Free and low-cost options included at every step, not just the expensive ones.
features.f4Description: Conversational coaching — voice or text — that remembers your full profile and past sessions. Ask anything from "Am I ready for promotion?" to "How do I transition into consulting?", then get meeting notes and a concrete action plan from every session, with one-click follow-through into your task list.
features.f5Description: {count} assessments across every career level — Leadership, AI Literacy, Emotional Intelligence, Strategic Thinking, and more — each with a scored band, situational case studies, and development actions.
features.f6Description: ATS compatibility audit, keyword gap analysis, achievement quality scoring, and visibility recommendations — all in one pass.
features.f7Description: Live role-play through real workplace situations — difficult feedback, delegation, conflict, restructuring conversations — organized by career level. The AI plays the other person realistically, then gives direct feedback grounded in what you actually said. Text or free browser voice.
features.f8Description: An AI-generated map of where you can realistically go from here — leadership, deep-expertise, and cross-functional branches, each role with your readiness percentage today, the skills it requires, your specific gaps, and an honest time-to-readiness. Grounded in your own gap analysis, not generic career ladders.
features.f9Description: A “you are here” view of your current destination role — Promotion Readiness and Interview Readiness scored from your real measured competencies, the fastest route to close your biggest gap, and a “what if?” simulator that recalculates your readiness instantly if you change your target or improve a skill.
features.f10Description: Track every certification and credential in one place, with expiry reminders so nothing lapses quietly.
features.f11Description: Small peer groups that keep momentum going — check in on each other's goals without needing a manager or coach in the loop.
features.f12Description: A LinkedIn-style profile — job history, skills, qualifications, career aspirations — auto-filled from the CV you already uploaded. Your Career Health trend, streaks, and achievements track your progress automatically as you use the platform.
features.f13Description: Turn any milestone into today's concrete steps with one click of AI, plan your week on a built-in calendar, and subscribe once to see it all inside your own Outlook, Google, or Apple calendar. A private AI Workspace turns your rough notes into summaries and action items. Fully private — never visible to your manager or organization, by design, not just by default.
features.f14Description: Company workspace with its own admin, full employee records (employee ID, title, department, business unit, manager, location — editable, archivable, exportable to Excel), a real org chart, a workforce skill inventory, a talent heatmap, and a custom competency framework mapped onto the scoring engine. Impact Cycles bring appraisals built on real global standards — past goals, KPI-linked focus areas, competency ratings, development needs, and dual sign-off — with a manager-only view scoped to just their own direct reports. Each company's data stays fully isolated from every other company.

methodology.label: Methodology
methodology.subtext: Devometrics follows the naming convention of econometrics, psychometrics, and biometrics — disciplines that apply rigorous, quantitative measurement to a domain. Here's what that means for how your score is actually built.
methodology.pillar1Title: A structured model, not a checklist
methodology.pillar1Description: Devometrics scores you against a defined competency taxonomy — technical, leadership, behavioral, strategic — instead of letting you self-report skills. Scoring is grounded in established, peer-reviewed competency-science research and behaviorally-anchored frameworks, not free-floating judgment or a single self-reported number.
methodology.pillar2Title: The gap moves with the market
methodology.pillar2Description: "Important" skills change. Target-role scoring is weighted against real job-description and market-demand data, so a gap map reflects what employers are asking for now, not a fixed rubric written once and never revisited.
methodology.pillar3Title: You see what the AI is sure of
methodology.pillar3Description: Every extracted competency carries a visible Confidence Score alongside its rating. When the model is inferring from limited signal, that's shown — not hidden behind a single clean-looking number.
methodology.pillar4Title: The plan updates as you do
methodology.pillar4Description: A gap analysis is a snapshot, not a verdict. As you complete milestones and the role or market shifts, your competency scores and plan are designed to be recalculated — not delivered once and left to go stale.
methodology.pillar5Title: Built for how adults actually learn
methodology.pillar5Description: Every recommendation is problem-centered and tied to a real situation you're facing, not abstract theory — and paced on your terms, not a fixed syllabus. We deliberately don't rely on "learning styles" (visual/auditory/kinesthetic) — that framework hasn't held up under research scrutiny. Your format preference shapes what keeps you motivated and consistent, not a diagnosis of how you supposedly learn best.
methodology.capabilityDescription: Every competency we score sits on one of three tiers — personal capability is the foundation, professional and technical execution builds on it, and organizational and leadership impact sits on top. Your own pyramid fills in with color as you complete assessments.
methodology.disclaimer: All scores are guidance, not a guarantee of career outcomes.

about.title: About Devometrics
about.p1: Devometrics is built on a simple premise: career development deserves the same rigor as any other discipline that takes measurement seriously. Not vague advice about "growth areas," but an honest, structured read of the gap between where you are and where a specific role actually needs you to be — plus a plan to close it.
about.p2: We're a small, focused team building under Empiric Consultancy. We'd rather ship something narrow and genuinely useful than something broad and generic, which is why the product leans on real inputs — your actual CV, a real target job description, structured competency frameworks — instead of one-size-fits-all career advice.
about.p3: We built the AI Coach and Interview Simulator because we think the two things that made executive coaching valuable — a continuous relationship and a safe place to rehearse hard conversations — shouldn't only be available to people with an executive coaching budget. And we built the gap analysis and Career Health Score because we think most career advice fails for a boring reason: it's never actually measured against you specifically.
about.p4: We're just getting started. We ship fast, we improve constantly, and we're adding new capabilities on a regular basis — this is a platform built to grow with the people who use it. If there's something you want to see next, we'd genuinely like to hear about it.

cookiesPage.title: Cookie Policy
cookiesPage.section1Body: Devometrics uses only the cookies required to keep you signed in — set by our authentication provider, Supabase, to maintain your session between page loads. We don't use advertising, tracking, or analytics cookies.
cookiesPage.section2Body: We store your theme preference (light/dark) in your browser's local storage so it persists between visits. This stays on your device and isn't sent to us.
cookiesPage.section3Body: We don't embed third-party trackers, ad networks, or social-media widgets that set their own cookies on this site.
cookiesPage.section4Body: Since the only cookies we set are required to keep you logged in, blocking them will prevent the dashboard from working. You can clear cookies for this site at any time through your browser settings — you'll just need to log in again afterward.

dataEthicsPage.title: Data Ethics
dataEthicsPage.section1BodyPrefix: Devometrics scores people using AI. That comes with real responsibility, and we'd rather state our principles plainly than let them be assumed. This page describes how we try to hold ourselves to them — it's a statement of intent, not a legal contract (see our
dataEthicsPage.section2Title: We show our uncertainty, not just a score
dataEthicsPage.section2Body: Every competency the AI extracts carries a visible Confidence Score. When the model is inferring from limited signal, that's shown next to the number — not hidden behind a single clean-looking figure.
dataEthicsPage.section3Body: Assessment results, gap analyses, and AI Coach feedback are self-report tools and AI-generated guidance — not certified psychometric evaluation, clinical assessment, or a guarantee of any career outcome. We say this directly in the product, not just in fine print.
dataEthicsPage.section4Title: No pseudoscience dressed up as science
dataEthicsPage.section4Body: We deliberately avoid building features on frameworks that sound authoritative but aren't supported by research — for example, we don't frame anything around "learning styles" (visual/auditory/kinesthetic), since that model has been repeatedly tested and hasn't held up. Where we can't back a claim with real evidence, we don't make it.
dataEthicsPage.section5Title: Your content isn't used to train anyone's model
dataEthicsPage.section5Body: The CV text, job descriptions, and messages you submit are sent to our AI provider only to generate your results, under an API agreement that excludes that data from model training.
dataEthicsPage.section6Title: What your employer can and can't see
dataEthicsPage.section6Body: If you join Devometrics through a company workspace, your organization's admins can see your Career Health Score, capability pyramid, and any milestones they've assigned you. They cannot see your day-to-day task list, your personal productivity tracking, or any individual survey answer — ever. Survey results only ever reach admins as anonymous aggregates, and only once at least 3 people have responded; below that, the results simply don't show. This is enforced in the database itself, not just hidden in the interface.
dataEthicsPage.section7Title: You can see and remove what we hold
dataEthicsPage.section7Body: Full data export and deletion are built into the product itself (dashboard → Data & privacy), not locked behind a support request. Deletion has a 30-day grace period so a mistaken click can be undone — after that window closes, it's permanent and we can no longer retrieve it.
dataEthicsPage.section8Body: Devometrics is designed as an input to your own judgment about your career, not a replacement for it. We don't make hiring, promotion, or compensation decisions, and we'd push back on any use of the platform that tried to make it do so unilaterally.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.s1BodyA: Account info you provide directly: name, email, and the profile details you choose to fill in (career stage, location, learning preference, accommodation, resource budget).
privacyPage.s1BodyB: Content you submit to use the product: your CV text, target job descriptions, discovery interview answers, assessment responses, AI Coach messages, and Interview Simulator conversation transcripts.
privacyPage.s1BodyC: We do not collect payment information today — there is no billing system active during the pilot phase.
privacyPage.s2Body: To generate your competency gap analysis, development plans, assessment results, resume analysis, and AI Coach and Interview Simulator responses. Your submitted content (CV text, job descriptions, assessment answers, coach messages) is sent to our AI provider, Anthropic, to generate these results — it is not used to train Anthropic's models under our current API agreement.
privacyPage.s3Body: In a Supabase-hosted PostgreSQL database, protected by row-level security policies that restrict each account to its own data. We don't sell your data or share it with advertisers.
privacyPage.s4Body: Anthropic (our AI provider, to generate responses), Supabase (our database and authentication provider), and — only for the small pilot-cohort admin view used to monitor pilot engagement — Empiric Consultancy staff administering the pilot. We don't share your data with any other third party.
privacyPage.s5Body: You can export everything stored about your account at any time from your dashboard's Data & privacy section, or delete your app data (plans, analyses, assessment results, coach and scenario history) the same way. Deleting app data doesn't delete your login — contact us if you want your account itself removed.
privacyPage.s6BodyA: We retain your data for as long as your account is active, or until you delete it.
privacyPage.s6BodyBPrefix: Deleting your app data or your company workspace does not remove it immediately. It schedules removal after a
privacyPage.s6BodyBSuffix: , during which everything keeps working normally and the deletion can be cancelled — this window exists solely to recover from an accidental deletion. Once the 30 days pass, the data is permanently and irreversibly deleted, and we are no longer able to retrieve it for any reason, except where we're required to retain records for legal reasons.
privacyPage.s7Body: Devometrics is not directed at children under 16, and we don't knowingly collect their data.
privacyPage.s8Body: We'll update the date at the top of this page if this policy changes materially.

nineBoxZones.legendTitle: 9-box zone guide — what each zone needs

highPotential.needs: Fast-track development and sponsorship — capability is behind, but growth signal is strong.

futureStar.needs: Accelerated growth plan and visibility — keep them engaged and challenged.

futureLeader.needs: Succession-ready. Retain deliberately and prepare for the transition.

roughDiamond.needs: Structured coaching and foundational skill-building before stretching further.

corePlayer.needs: Steady development and broader exposure — the dependable middle of the org.

trustedProfessional.needs: Stretch assignments and more visibility so capability keeps compounding.

needsAttention.needs: Address directly — closer coaching, a performance plan, or a role that fits better.

inconsistent.needs: Closer management and fundamentals — capability is present but growth has stalled.

plateaued.needs: New challenges to reignite growth — capable but at risk of disengaging.

highPotentialPage.title: High Potential Pool
highPotentialPage.description: A consolidated, cross-role roster of everyone in the top-growth-signal row of your talent grid — not tied to one specific role. Complements Succession Planning: that page answers "who fits this critical role," this one answers "who across the whole organization deserves deliberate investment right now," juniors included.

highPotentialPage.noMeasuredData: No one on your team has run a Gap Analysis yet, so there's no measured data to place anyone on the grid. This isn't a reflection of your team — the tools just haven't been used yet.
highPotentialPage.noOneInTopRow: No one currently lands in the top growth-signal row of the grid. {measured} of {total} employees have measured data — as more people run a Gap Analysis (and complete assessments in the Leadership-adjacent dimensions), this pool will start to populate honestly rather than by inference.
highPotentialPage.measuredNote: Based only on measured Gap Analysis competency levels — no demographic attributes, tenure, or manager opinion factor into this. Someone missing from this list may simply be undermeasured, not lower-potential; {measured} of {total} employees have run a Gap Analysis so far.
highPotentialPage.futureLeaderBlurb: High measured capability and strong leadership growth signal — your nearest-term succession bench. These are the people Succession Planning should already be scoring against your critical roles.
highPotentialPage.futureStarBlurb: Solid capability with strong growth signal — engaged and ready to be stretched further with visibility and bigger assignments.
highPotentialPage.highPotentialBlurb: Capability is still developing, but the growth signal is strong — this is typically where early-career and junior employees who are quietly outperforming their tenure show up. The highest-leverage group for deliberate investment: sponsorship, stretch assignments, and structured development, before capability catches up on its own.

successionBoard.emptyState: Start with the role whose sudden vacancy would hurt most. The AI ranks your current people against it using their measured competency data — fit, readiness, gaps, and what to develop — so the succession conversation starts from evidence.
successionBoard.methodologyP1: Rankings are grounded exclusively in each person's measured competency data on this platform (gap analyses, assessments) — following the selection-science principle that structured, multi-source evidence outperforms unstructured judgment (the meta-analytic tradition of Schmidt & Hunter, 1998). The AI never considers age, gender, nationality, or anything beyond the competency evidence.
successionBoard.methodologyP2: This is decision support, not a decision. Fit scores reflect data quality: someone who hasn't run a Gap Analysis can't rank well, which is a data gap, not a verdict on them — the risk note flags this. Use the ranking to structure a human succession conversation, alongside performance history and context this platform doesn't capture.
